title: David Winter's Burns Reading Room British Traditions January  -  Box + COA + Pin
descriptionText: This is a small, handmade resin house titled "David Winter's Burns Reading Room" from the British Traditions series. Manufactured in 1989 in the United Kingdom, it features a multicolor design and comes boxed with a certificate of authenticity and a pin. Created by artist David Winter, this piece depicts a cozy house inspired by Burn's Reading Room. Perfect for any room, it is part of the David Winter collection and suitable for all occasions.
